jobs_results.title: Senior Social Media Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Hi, we’re Fever
We’re excited you are checking out this job offer.

We are the leading global live-entertainment discovery tech platform with a clear mission: to democratize access to culture and entertainment.

How do we achieve our mission? Fever has developed a proprietary technology that inspires a global community of over 125M people through personalized and curated experiences in their local city whilst empowering entertainment and event creators to reach new audiences and enhance their experience.

Sounds amazing, right?

About you:
• Native-level proficiency in oral and written English and Spanish. Knowledge of French, Portuguese, German, or Italian is a plus.
• Deep passion for Digital Marketing. Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience focused on digital portfolio projects.
• +4 years of experience as a senior account manager, project manager, senior social media manager, digital strategist, or similar role.
• Strong management skills with... excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication and presentation skills.
• Proactive in seeking clarification of requirements and direction; takes responsibility and ownership to manage projects.
• Stay up-to-date with digital technology trends and have a strong understanding of digital media trends, with the ability to identify what makes content popular online.
• Ability to track relevant community KPIs and proficiency in project management methodologies and tools.
• Strong aesthetic sense to provide clear feedback on assets and visual campaigns.
• Ability to adapt to the fast-paced environment of a digital startup business.
• Love being part of a dynamic team in a growing company and being able to work in teams towards a shared goal.
• Based in or able to relocate to Madrid, Spain.
• Familiarity with Canva and CapCut (knowledge of other design/edit tools is a plus).

About the role:
• Creative Ideation and Feedback: Support creative development through brainstorming and idea conceptualization. Provide clear feedback on strategy, creative assets, and workflows.
• Content Proposal Support: Assist in content proposals aligned with multichannel content strategies for different target audiences.
• Branding and Innovation: Conduct branding checks and provide assistance on different social media channels. Bring unique ideas to improve and manage international communities on social media.
• Video Production Coordination and Equipment Management: Coordinate video requests and streamline workflow processes. Manage team equipment needs and inventory.
• Cross-Team Collaboration Facilitation: Collaborate with internal teams (Creative, Marketing Acquisition, CRM, etc.) in 360º campaigns. Encourage collaboration across teams, markets, and departments on social media strategy.
• Partnership Relationship Support: Build relationships with partners, customers, potential customers, industry professionals, and influencers. Assist in partner relations management.
• Workflow Management: Coordinate with management, community managers, and other departments to foster collaboration and achieve shared goals. Standardize workflows through document creation. Manage workload and prioritize projects based on time tracking data.
• Mentorship and Team Management: Craft personalized growth plans and provide actionable feedback to team members.
• Training Coordination and Oversight: Oversee onboarding, internal department training, and coordinate cross-department training initiatives.
• Social Media Tool Management: Manage and optimize the use of social media tools for efficiency and effectiveness. Provide and research new solutions.

Benefits & Perks
• Attractive compensation package including base salary and potential for significant bonus based on performance.
• Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader.
• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences.
• Work in a central location in Madrid, with possible travel across markets.
• Home-office friendly environment.
• Responsibility from day one with opportunities for professional and personal growth.
• Great work environment with a young, international team of talented individuals.
• Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee
• English Lessons
• Free food, drinks, and fruit at the office!
• Possibility to receive part of salary in advance by Payflow
• Gympass membership

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We look forward to learning more about you!

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs_results.title: Senior Project Manager, Art Creative Services 2D + 3D
jobs_results.description:
Scopely is looking for a highly motivated Senior Project Manager to join our Marketing team Flamed in Barcelona Office on a Hybrid basis!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

We are the in-house creative agency, Flamed, an International multidisciplinary team. We build thousands of creatives every year to support all Scopely games Marketing needs worldwide. You will work on the leading mobile casual "Monopoly Go", mid-core games like Star Trek Fleet Command and Stumble Guys, among others.

What You Will Do
In this role, you will handle a dynamic creative team in Barcelona and several external creative agencies in the US and EU. You’ll oversee the... daily tracking of each creative project, ensuring that creative team utilization, budgets, and creative quality goals are met or exceeded. Organization, foresight and attention to detail is a requirement; the PM should be highly organized, a strong communicator, and process driven. Work closely with the Strategy and RPG Team and the rest of the team to deliver a high number of projects per month in a timely and effective manner.
• Work closely with the Art Director and the rest of the team to deliver a high number of projects per month in a timely and effective manner and reporting to the Producer Manager
• Lead the management of your game/s asset development with internal and external teams, including Design, 3D assets, statics, and Re-sizing projects.
• Direct the creative team on these efforts, organize their queues and handle asset delivery to the asset management tool.
• Effectively balance multiple high-priority assignments and allocations for the creative department across both internal and external teams.
• Provide regular feedback to the marketing and creative teams on priorities and deadlines.
• Collaborate with internal product teams and external development teams on game assets.
• Assist the internal review and approvals process.
• Demonstrate clear ownership and accountability, delivering creative assets on time, within budget, to a high level of quality
• Communicate clearly between the team to guarantee alignment on expectations, lead asset changes efficiently and is able to prioritize P
• Pro-actively sets and leads meetings with internal and external collaborators to communicate on projects, status, issues or changes maintaining the teams' aligned

What We’re Looking For
• 6+ years of Project and Creative Management with a strong experience in advertising, creative services or production.
• Experience working closely with creative teams and creative projects
• Strong organization skills and attention to detail
• Passionate, committed and humble
• Experience with Digital assets and asset management
• Excellent communication skills in English
• Spanish is a plus
• Video games or Mobile games experience is a plus
• Creative pipeline knowledge is a plus
Hybrid, based 1-2 days a week in Scoplely's offices in Barcelona, with 4/5 days work from home/remotely.
Please include a portfolio or PDF/links to examples of your work in the application.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Us
Scopely is a global interactive entertainment and mobile-first video game company, home to many top, award-winning experiences such as "MONOPOLY GO!," “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “Stumble Guys,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” and “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” among others.
Scopely creates, publishes, and live-operates immersive games that empower a directed-by-consumer™ experience across multiple platforms—from mobile, web, PC and beyond.
Founded in 2011, Scopely is fueled by a world-class team and a proprietary technology platform Playgami that supports one of the most diversified portfolios in the games industry.
Recognized multiple times as one of Fast Company’s “World’s Most Innovative Companies,” Scopely is a multi-billion-dollar business due to its ability to create long-lasting game experiences that players enjoy for years.
Scopely has global operations in more than a dozen markets across Asia, EMEA, and North America, and is home to many internal game development teams, referred to as Scopely Studios, with additional game studio partners across four continents.
Scopely was acquired by Savvy Games Group in July 2023 for $4.9 billion, and is now an independent subsidiary of Savvy.

For more information on Scopely, visit: scopely.com

Notice to candidates: Scopely, Inc and its affiliates will never request payment or ask for financial information as a condition for applying to a position or receiving an offer of employment.All official Scopely, Inc. recruiters only use email domains that end with @scopely.com.

Our official website is www.scopely.com. Please only apply to positions posted on our official website and ensure the recruiter only communicates via the official email domain.

It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters, join our global team.

Manages - with responsibility for results - projects in the context of manufacturing.

It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters, join our global team.

Manages - with responsibility for results - projects in the context of manufacturing.

Siemens Gamesa has a vision for renewable energy: we believe in the power of nature and technology. Help us to be ready to face the energy challenges of tomorrow and make a green footprint – join the team in creating a better future for us on our planet.

We focus on hiring the best people, wherever they may be in the world. We pride ourselves on the flexibility we offer to our employees and are committed to building a... workforce that can grow with the company. Siemens Gamesa is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

In our culture of trust, we focus on empowerment, diversity and continuous learning. Valuing our people is what makes us one global team, with our colleagues’ safety at the heart of our organization.

We are looking for Experienced Project Manager for our Global Nacelle PMO department in Brande with experience in leading manufacturing projects within New Product Introduction, Technology Transfer and New Plant Set Up.

The Project Manager will manage, lead, develop internal procedures to ensure that the project team achieves set goals in accordance with agreed timeline, budget and quality. Our project portfolio extends on global scale and will primarily consist of:
• Planning and Executing New Factories
• New Product Development & Introduction
• Technology Transfer

We provide a highly complex and exiting working environment where we expect that the Project Manager is skilled in leading the constructive cooperation cross internal & external stakeholders.

A high skill of communication is required for the ideal candidate for this position to manage the cooperation amongst the stakeholders, prepare reports and present to management.

Key Role:
• Lead New Product Development & Introduction.
• Lead new factory set up with production line and technology transfers cross plants.
• Preferably the candidate has prior experience in the Wind Manufacturing or similar industry.
• Leading the feasibility, planning, development & execution of the project.
• The PM is responsible to secure that the project deliverables are managed from the resources allocated to the project according to projects time schedule, quality and budget.
• While the Project Manager does not have direct reports, she or he will lead a project team with resources allocated by various resource owners in the organization.
• The PM is responsible to secure that the project deliverables are handed from the resources allocated to the project according to projects time schedule, quality and budget.
• Mentor for younger experienced PMs (if qualified and needed)

Key tasks involve:
• All project management activities from project scoping to handover.
• Responsible for the overall success of the project, leading the project team, manage and reporting to Steering Committee and stakeholders.
• Accountable for approved OPEX and CAPEX budget (double digit mEUR)
• Negotiate resources allocation to the project.
• Facilitate project team (project size around 20-60 people) and stakeholder meetings & workshops.
• Set up planning & reporting structure for tracking & following up on the progress of the project.

What you need to make a difference

Passion for renewable energy and a sense for the importance to lead the change with following requirements:
• Engineer or person with a technical background, or equivalent experience within industry.
• Experienced Project Management background. People management would be a plus as well as IPMA-C/B certification or similar.
• Fluent in English as we are a Global function.
• Solid communication skills to manage communication cross complex organization and stakeholders
• Able to co-operate across different cultures and personalities.
• Energetic with follow-through attitude.
• Structured and able to multitask in good order.
• Willing to travel as needed which will be aprox 2-4 month per year (intensified during installation and Start of Production).

It is a big advantage if you thrive in a multi-cultural environment and are familiar with working in large organizations. It is therefore important that you have excellent English language skills, both written and spoken.

In case you have acquired your skills in alternative ways your application is just as well appreciated.

In return of your commitment we offer you

Become a part of our mission for sustainability: Clean energy for generations to come. We are a global team of diverse colleagues who share a passion for renewable energy and have a culture of trust and empowerment to make our own ideas a reality. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization. Siemens Gamesa offers a wide variety of benefits such as flexible working hours as well as home-office possibility for many colleagues, employer-funded pension, attractive remuneration package (fixed/variable) and local benefits such as subsided lunch, employee discounts and much more.

Empowering our people

System Design Coordinates with Technical Lead Engineer(s) on system architecture, and specifies and orders equipment through ERP. Expedites system component shipping, inspection and payment.

External Supply Coordinates with Supply Chain on project related aspects of external supply. Assists in technical specification preparation and subsequent order negotiations and supplier payments. Quality Ensures that all company and customer quality procedures are met. Ensures all project documentation is control and where necessary delivered in a timing manner to the customer.

# of indirect reports Project Team

Understanding of Project scheduling techniques

Basic financial concepts

Knowledge of Process automation systems

Competences

Systematic Problem Solving: Able to apply systems thinking to generate solutions; focus on process rather than isolated events; obtain multiple assessments of a situation and be systematic in identifying trouble spots; use tools to define problems; evaluate alternative solutions.

Engineering Degree.

jobs_results.description:
Do you want to work for a company whose purpose is to improve society by considering social outcomes, and to transform businesses, communities, and opportunities for its employees?

Mott MacDonald is currently seeking experienced engineers to join our growing renewable energy team. The role will include acting as Senior Project Manager in the delivery of Due Diligence assignments on large scale energy onshore and offshore wind projects working for a diverse range of clients on the Lenders side (LTA) and on M&A assignments (VDD and ADD).
As a Senior Project Manager, you will be expected to work hand-in-hand across Mott MacDonald's Group to form large project teams and deliver on our global projects. The role will also act as an internal expert for wind advisory projects to provide support and mentoring to less experienced staff in the delivery of project work.
Duties and responsibilities of the successful candidate will include, among others:
• Managing onshore and offshore wind... advisory assignments including but not limited to lenders due diligence, acquisition due diligence and vendors due diligence of development, construction and operational wind projects.
• Communicating, coordinating and corresponding with clients for all the matters related to the assignments, acting as primary point of contact on behalf of Mott MacDonald.
• Lead and manage multi-disciplinary project teams working closely with other Mott MacDonald business teams to establish an internal ‘delivery’ network as needed.
• Manage and hold overall project delivery responsibility for projects ensuring budgets are delivered on time, to a high quality and on budget.
• Manage and actively identify all critical risks, issues and impacts of the project.
• At short notice, act upon and deliver ad-hoc engineering technical input into projects managed by other peers at various stages (from feasibility to preliminary and detailed design, construction and operational stages) without losing focus on major ongoing projects.
• Undertake or provide guidance on technical reviews of engineering design documentation prepared by third parties and report on findings.
• Undertake or provide guidance on technical reviews of construction and operations contracts including but not limited to PPA, EPC (or TSA+BOP) and O&M.
• Undertake or provide guidance on technical reviews of financial models with special emphasis on project lifetime assumptions and derived impacts on OPEX and performance degradation.

Candidate Specification:
• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering
• Be highly motivated, with a versatile personality and excellent interpersonal skills.
• Professional experience as an engineer with demonstrable experience of project management of wind projects, either as developer or consultant, such that in this client facing role you can guide technical discussions and make recommendations.
• The successful candidate will be required to produce and review/authorise technical reports for clients, so attention to detail is paramount.
• Able to collate, examine and act upon complex and diverse information from a variety of sources and give advice for project level decision making.
• Ability to communicate clearly and concisely in English, both verbally and written and ability to explain technical issues to technical and non-technical colleagues, including clients.
• Experience of working within a multi-disciplinary engineering environment and on international projects, managing country and region-specific factors. The candidate shall be comfortable working with global teams located in different countries.
• Ability to manage people effectively to deliver required outputs in a timely manner
• Ability to influence and motivate stakeholders within a complex environment
• Ability to identify and match resources and skills to appropriate project roles
• Ability to guide and present at meetings
• Flexibility and willingness to travel internationally

We are actively recruiting a diverse workforce that is reflective of the communities we serve. We recognise that differences in ability, skills and experience are a strength and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

Mott MacDonald is currently seeking experienced engineers to join our growing renewable energy team. The role will include acting as Senior Project Manager in the delivery of Due Diligence assignments on large scale energy onshore and offshore wind projects working for a diverse range of clients on the Lenders side (LTA) and on M&A assignments (VDD and ADD).
As a Senior Project Manager, you will be expected to work hand-in-hand across Mott MacDonald's Group to form large project teams and deliver on our global projects. The role will also act as an internal expert for wind advisory projects to provide support and mentoring to less experienced staff in the delivery of project work.
Duties and responsibilities of the successful candidate will include, among others:
• Managing onshore and offshore wind... advisory assignments including but not limited to lenders due diligence, acquisition due diligence and vendors due diligence of development, construction and operational wind projects.
• Communicating, coordinating and corresponding with clients for all the matters related to the assignments, acting as primary point of contact on behalf of Mott MacDonald.
• Lead and manage multi-disciplinary project teams working closely with other Mott MacDonald business teams to establish an internal ‘delivery’ network as needed.
• Manage and hold overall project delivery responsibility for projects ensuring budgets are delivered on time, to a high quality and on budget.
• Manage and actively identify all critical risks, issues and impacts of the project.
• At short notice, act upon and deliver ad-hoc engineering technical input into projects managed by other peers at various stages (from feasibility to preliminary and detailed design, construction and operational stages) without losing focus on major ongoing projects.
• Undertake or provide guidance on technical reviews of engineering design documentation prepared by third parties and report on findings.
• Undertake or provide guidance on technical reviews of construction and operations contracts including but not limited to PPA, EPC (or TSA+BOP) and O&M.
• Undertake or provide guidance on technical reviews of financial models with special emphasis on project lifetime assumptions and derived impacts on OPEX and performance degradation.

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering
• Be highly motivated, with a versatile personality and excellent interpersonal skills.
• Professional experience as an engineer with demonstrable experience of project management of wind projects, either as developer or consultant, such that in this client facing role you can guide technical discussions and make recommendations.
• The successful candidate will be required to produce and review/authorise technical reports for clients, so attention to detail is paramount.
• Able to collate, examine and act upon complex and diverse information from a variety of sources and give advice for project level decision making.
• Ability to communicate clearly and concisely in English, both verbally and written and ability to explain technical issues to technical and non-technical colleagues, including clients.
• Experience of working within a multi-disciplinary engineering environment and on international projects, managing country and region-specific factors. The candidate shall be comfortable working with global teams located in different countries.
• Ability to manage people effectively to deliver required outputs in a timely manner
• Ability to influence and motivate stakeholders within a complex environment
• Ability to identify and match resources and skills to appropriate project roles
• Ability to guide and present at meetings
• Flexibility and willingness to travel internationally

jobs_results.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
**Job Description Summary**: The Senior Services Project Manager is responsible for the management of complex aftermarket projects in Power Service and is accountable to deliver projects to contract requirements, cost, quality and EHS targets whilst maintaining customer satisfactions.

The Projects will typically be Complex Conversions, Modifications, and Upgrades (CM&Us), rehabilitations or relocations on a brown field site Industrial Heavy-Duty Gas Turbines, Aero-derivative Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, Generators, Heat Recovery Steam Generators, and/or balance-of-plant equipment. The solutions will require full integration, extensive design work and coordination between the matrix fulfillment functions, often with new products introduction, hence robust scope, change management, cost and design control is required. The projects will also be demanding in terms of stakeholder management, cost control, documentation, schedule, customer and installation management.
• *Roles and... Responsibilities**
- Serve as the GE representative and focal point for the customer on the project, owning the customer relationship for the project duration and driving customer issue resolution.
- Engage and support in offer/tendering phase bringing experience and lessons and ensuring gaps are closed, fulfilment capabilities and execution strategy are robust to ensure the project can be successful in execution.
- Define and implement the Project execution strategy, challenging all aspects of the project setup with overall object to ensure success of project
- Own project execution, including cross-functional coordination of engineering, procurement, shipping logistics, field/ outage execution and performance demonstration.
- Provide Project Leadership, effectively managing and facilitating cross-functional GE teams to ensure on time delivery, contract deliverables fulfilment, and margin attainment/ enhancement.
- Understand and implement Contract Terms & Conditions.
- Manage project financials: price, cost, forecasts, margin, invoicing, and receivables. Manage project risk provisions and participate in Margin Reviews.
- Drive project schedule; work with Project Planner/Scheduler on schedule creation and management.
- Proactively identify, manage, and mitigate project risks throughout the project lifecycle. Escalate risks and issues as needed for resolution.
- Define and manage the strategy for claims management
- Provide project status updates and lead Project Reviews as required.
- Capture and report project best practices/ lessons learned and Cost-of-Poor Quality cases.
- Stakeholder management and communication including Customer, Region, PMO, Senior Management, Consortium members
- Follow Conversions, Modifications and Upgrades (CM&U) Project Management processes.
• *Required Qualifications**
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business or other technical or business related field
- Extensive Project Management experience in Turnkey, large scale services projects for Power Generation or particularly complex extended scope projects
- PMP Certification, Project Management Leadership Program (PMLP) Graduate, or other Project Management training
- Maintain PMO Project Manager Qualification status through ongoing training and recertification as required.
- Willingness and ability to travel for extended periods
• *Desired Characteristics**
- Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
- Global service experience and ability to lead projects in cross functional and international teams
- Knowledge of Power Services Engineering across multiple products, services and associated markets
- Broad commercial and negotiation knowledge and experience
- Understanding of business and project financials (orders, sales, CM, OM, Pacing, Margin Review, Cash)
- Strong analytical, project management organizational skills
- Embraces and demonstrates sensitivity to culture of customer and internal team members.
• *Additional Information**:
• *Relocation Assistance Provided**:No
